latin_text: above the heavens, the waters are the minds of the cherubim. But see what a disparity of condition there is in the same nature: the elemental moisture quenches the heat of life; the celestial feeds it; the supercelestial understands it.
english_translation: above the heavens, the waters are the minds of the cherubim. But see what a disparity of condition there is in the same nature: the elemental moisture quenches the heat of life; the celestial feeds it; the supercelestial understands it.
exegesis: The cherubim (second triad of angelic hierarchy) are identified with intelligible forms and cosmic understanding. Water symbolizes knowledge at all levels.
notes: HARVESTER passage: H.SP.4 | Cherubim as intelligence and intelligible forms; cherubic knowledge as cosmic understanding
